tagline: Find what can still be saved.
source_help: Choose a raw disk image. The source is opened for reading only.
image: Source image or explicit device path
advanced_help: FAT16/FAT32 images, MBR and 512-byte GPT. For an explicit device, enter \\.\PhysicalDriveN. Device access may be denied; no elevation is requested.
safety_help: Restore to a separate folder. Never repair the source in place. Overwritten or SSD-discarded content may be unrecoverable.
supported_help: Deleted FAT16/FAT32 entries and retained chains; free contiguous clusters when chains were cleared. PNG carving validates chunk bounds and CRCs. Other filesystems use PNG carving only.
result_help: Select files with Ctrl or Shift. Previews show bounded text or bytes; nothing is executed.
preview_empty: Select a file to inspect its text or bytes.
empty: No files found yet. Start a scan or resume a saved scan.
scan_limited: Scan ended with limits or unreadable areas
checkpoint_error: Files found, but scan progress could not be saved
restore_title: Give recovered files a new home
restore_help: Choose an existing folder. Existing files are kept; duplicate names receive a number. Original paths remain visible in the results, while output filenames are flattened.
uncertain: FAT recovery is uncertain even when all bytes are readable. Partial outputs end in .partial. A valid PNG container does not guarantee intact pixels.
up_to_date: You have the latest published stable version
update_failed: Update service unavailable; try again later
install_failed: Update could not be installed; the original app is preserved
update_help: Startup checks run in the background. Installation starts only when you choose it, verifies SHA-256, and restarts the app. Preferences and scan progress are kept.
error: This action could not be completed
invalid_offset: Enter a valid non-negative byte offset
note_chain: The layout follows a retained chain. Clusters may have been reused. Verify the saved file.
note_contiguous: The FAT was cleared. Continuity is inferred and may be wrong for fragmented or overwritten files.
note_partial: Only a readable prefix is available. Missing bytes cannot be reconstructed.
note_png: Chunk order, bounds and CRCs checked. Pixel decoding is not verified; this may also be a live file.
busy: Wait for the current operation or stop it safely.
settings_help: Appearance, language and updates in one place.
